user.title: Carbon Savings
user.description: Global factors used by all sources. The grid intensity sensor (e.g. Electricity Maps) is optional; the fallback is used whenever it is missing or unavailable.

data_description.grid_intensity_sensor: Sensor in gCO2eq/kWh, e.g. from the Electricity Maps integration.
data_description.grid_fallback: Used when no sensor is set or it is unavailable.
data_description.tree_mode: Fixed: CO2 ÷ kg per tree. Growth curve: how many trees planted when each source went into operation would have absorbed its savings by today.
data_description.tree_factor: kg CO2 that equal one planted tree in fixed mode (e.g. 60 kg = seedling grown for 10 years, US EPA). Also used for sources without a start date.
data_description.tree_rate_young: kg CO2 per year of a freshly planted tree (growth curve).
data_description.tree_rate_mature: kg CO2 per year of a mature tree (growth curve).
data_description.tree_years_to_mature: Uptake grows linearly from first-year to mature value over this period.

abort.already_configured: Carbon Savings is already configured. Add sources (PV, vehicles, heat pump) to the existing entry.

user.title: PV system
user.description: Every produced kWh is credited with the grid intensity.

data_description.production_sensor: Lifetime (total increasing) PV production, e.g. the inverter's Modbus energy counter.
data_description.initial_value: kg CO2 saved before tracking started (e.g. value from the SolarEdge portal).
data_description.start_date: Date the source went into operation. Used for the tree growth curve.

user.title: Electric vehicle
user.description: Savings per km = combustion reference − EV electricity × grid intensity. All charging (home and public) is charged at grid intensity, PV gets its credit separately.

data_description.ev_consumption_sensor: Long-term average consumption reported by the vehicle integration (kWh/100km, Wh/km or km/kWh). Values outside 5–60 kWh/100 km are ignored.
data_description.ev_consumption: Average consumption of the electric vehicle. Used when no sensor is selected or it is unavailable.
data_description.charging_loss: Added on top of the consumption.
data_description.ice_consumption: Consumption of a comparable combustion car.
data_description.initial_value: kg CO2 saved before tracking started (e.g. value from the SolarEdge portal).
data_description.start_date: Date the source went into operation. Used for the tree growth curve.
